Dependency: puff 2.3
Upstream author: Mark Adler
Upstream location: zlib contrib/puff
Upstream version date: 2013-01-21
License: zlib

TostónSync vendors puff.c and puff.h to decode standard DEFLATE streams while
extracting ZIP backups. The upstream license notice is preserved in puff.h.
No intentional functional modifications were made to the puff implementation.
